headlines: Chatter ties the selloff to OpenAI annualised revenue near $50B versus the $70B earlier reported (unconfirmed by OpenAI per a Stocktwits-linked post)
Semis and AI-cloud names sliding: SOXL -11%, INTC -6%, CIFR -11%, IREN -8%, QQQ -1.6% while IWM is only -0.2%
TLT +0.9% and GLD +0.7%: bonds and gold bid

rumors.text: OpenAI told investors annualised revenue is near $50B, about $20B below the $70B reported earlier; a bull counter says the $70B was never confirmed and $50B is still strong growth
rumors.why: An AI-demand disappointment would keep pressure on chip and AI-capex names and the Nasdaq-heavy index

rumors.text: Posters expect a squeeze or bounce around 3 pm once 0DTE options are spent, with support near 770-772
rumors.why: Dip-buying and short covering could lift the index into the close if the 770 area holds

rumors.text: Posters say the market already got what it needed on Iran and the dip should be bought
rumors.why: Easing geopolitical risk would remove a headwind and support a rebound

plays.reason: Tech-led weakness (QQQ -1.6%, semis -6 to -11%) with bonds and gold bid; but SPY is near its day low and the crowd is leaning to dip-buying, so edge is thin
plays.catalyst: OpenAI revenue chatter and AI-semis selloff

readings.whats_new: SPY is flat versus an hour ago at about 772 (-0.68%) while QQQ slid to -1.6% and semis accelerated lower (SOXL -11%, INTC -6%). Fear and greed eased to 38 (fear) from 42 and VIX is steady near 15.5. The OpenAI revenue story is still the main explanation and is being re-shared, and the crowd stays bullish with dip-buy and 3 pm squeeze calls.
